Design.evidence_source: [page/4/Text/2] In the treatment Transparency both players are fully informed about the true state. [page/5/Text/0] In the Non-Transparency treatment the proposer is ignorant about the true state but the responder knows. [page/5/Text/1] In a third treatment, Choice, the proposer can choose between remaining ignorant about the occurring state or to reveal the state. ... To push the idea of the perception of hostile intentions a bit further we designed a modified version of the Choice treatment, Choice Uncertain Revelation... [page/6/Text/0] In a fifth treatment, Choice Hidden, the responder is not informed whether the proposer revealed the state or not.
